description: Twelve fixed synthetic user requests for an internal paired comparison of the same live model with and without the generic text-triggered guard. This file intentionally contains no class labels, rationales, pressure categories, or per-item authorization metadata. Trusted authorization state is constant and specified only in the preregistration.
